programme.title: Veggies Veggies Everywhere
programme.desc: Today, we'll be showing you how to use green veggies in every meal, including snacks! We hope you're ready, because Mom wants you to eat all the veggies on your plate!

programme.title: Pizza Time
programme.desc: Today we've got pizza all day for you: in the morning, in the evening, literally any time you want! Not only will we share some great recipes but we will let you know which ones are our favorites too. What are we waiting for? Let's get to the pizza!

programme.title: Crock Pots and Steamers
programme.desc: Today, we'll be checking out some incredible recipes that can be made in a crock pot or a steamer! From soups to regular meals, even right down to some unconventional ideas, we've got it all. Plug in those crock pots, it's time to get steamy!

programme.title: European Adventure
programme.desc: Today, we embark on a European Adventure! We'll be visiting the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Greece to check out their culinary wonders. So what are we waiting for? Let's get to it!

programme.title: Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: When the cold and snowy season descends upon us, it's only fitting you'll want some delicious, home-cooked food to warm you up. Good thing we're taking a trip through our Winter Wonderland today! So toss aside those mittens... it's time to cook!

programme.title: Dumplings, Steam Buns, and Dim Sum, Oh My!
programme.desc: In a city with over 60 Michelin star restaurants, one brother will live and dine like a king, while the other will check out the city’s more affordable street food scene.

programme.title: Simplicity vs. Splendor on the Seaside
programme.desc: Soaking in the beauty and elegance of the French Riviera, Marko and Alex are in Nice to enjoy the simplicity and splendor of this seaside city.

programme.title: Keep Austin Weird
programme.desc: In the state capital of Texas, Marko and Alex see what Austin has to offer. An eclectic city known for its music and cuisine, the guys brave the Texas heat and check out what keeps Austin weird.

programme.title: Levels of Luxury in Laos
programme.desc: Sandwiched between Thailand, Vietnam, and Cambodia, Laos is a destination often overlooked by tourists. Marko and Alex are uncovering the hidden gem of Vientiane, the capital city, to see what goes on in this sleepy town beside the Mekong River.

programme.title: The Gainful Grace of Geneva
programme.desc: Marko and Alex find themselves in the prosperous and pristine city of Geneva, Switzerland. A city nestled alongside a beautiful glacier-fed lake, the guys will explore the riches Geneva has to offer.

programme.title: The Thriving Traditions of Taipei
programme.desc: ​Welcome to the buzzing capital of Taiwan. A rich blend of cultures, old meets new in this thriving metropolis of Taipei. Marko and Alex eat their way through the city, experiencing some unique traditions along the way.

programme.title: The Lion's Share of Lyon
programme.desc: Marko and Alex head to Lyon, France, a city known for its gastronomy and endless history.

programme.title: Oceanside in Okinawa
programme.desc: Ocean breeze, turquoise waters and a whole lot of amazing cuisine. Marko and Alex are soaking up that island life in Okinawa, Japan and learning what makes it so unique.

programme.title: Genoa From Above and Below
programme.desc: In Genoa, the brothers cruise the streets, while one of them gets a taste for the lavish lifestyle of Italy's Northwestern port. They take in all the views: heads in the clouds on a high-flying funicular, and just above water at the local aquarium.

programme.title: The L.A. Lifestyle
programme.desc: Green juice, avocado toast, and surfers galore. Marko and Alex are back home in Los Angeles to explore their town, staycation style. From downtown to the beach, the guys do everything fun under the sun in the city of angels.

programme.desc: From a chef making Italian pasta with Mexican flavors to a groundbreaking functional cocktail bar to a couple that roasts whole goats behind a tire shop, Stephanie Izard finds unique eateries serving up one-of-a-kind food.

programme.title: Family Style
programme.desc: From brothers selling mom’s Syrian food to a Filipino family remixing a classic dessert to a mom and son running an Indian restaurant out of their house, Stephanie meets multi-gen families turning family recipes into smash hit food business.

programme.title: Home Cooking
programme.desc: From a homerun Greek dinner party series to a backyard that’s become a gourmet deli to a Burmese pop up running out of an apartment kitchen, Stephanie Izard meets cooks finding ingenious ways to serve mouth-watering food out of their houses.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Spring Fling is here, and we're going to show you some fantastic recipes to enjoy some well deserved time in the sun. What are we waiting for? Let's check it out!

programme.title: Italian Classics
programme.desc: On this episode, we're going to show you some of our favorite Italian classics. Pasta, pizza, and more... you name it, we've got it. So, what are you waiting for? It's time to get cooking!

programme.title: Eating Vegan
programme.desc: On this episode of Tastemade's Recipe Rundown, we're switching things up and running on pure plant power! That's right, today we're featuring some incredible vegan eats!

programme.title: A Trip to Latin America
programme.desc: We hope you brought your passport, because we're heading to Latin America! Whether it's breakfast, lunch, dinner or dessert, we're going to show you some delicious dishes, each with their own unique Latin flair!

programme.title: Southern Home Cooking
programme.desc: Today, we're going on a trip down south for a taste of some country home cooking. Our quest for the best southern dish covers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and of course, dessert. But we better get moving, they're ringing the dinner bell!

programme.title: Cheese!
programme.desc: Today, it's all about cheese: from the melted gooey-ness to just plain old slices, cheese makes the world go round. We'll showcase recipes that feature cheese in all forms. So strap in, it's time to get cheesy.

programme.title: Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Today, we're going on an adventure to the Mediterranean! We're making our way to the cool blue waters of the sea to find the best recipes from all over the region. Every segment, we'll present a few and then show you our favorite. Opa!

programme.title: Veggies Veggies Everywhere
programme.desc: Today, we'll be showing you how to use green veggies in every meal, including snacks! We hope you're ready, because Mom wants you to eat all the veggies on your plate!

programme.title: Pizza Time
programme.desc: Today we've got pizza all day for you: in the morning, in the evening, literally any time you want! Not only will we share some great recipes but we will let you know which ones are our favorites too. What are we waiting for? Let's get to the pizza!

programme.title: Crock Pots and Steamers
programme.desc: Today, we'll be checking out some incredible recipes that can be made in a crock pot or a steamer! From soups to regular meals, even right down to some unconventional ideas, we've got it all. Plug in those crock pots, it's time to get steamy!

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: Bake in the New Year!
programme.desc: Mia is ringing in the new year with these chic bakes. Fortune cookies for luck, a champagne dessert, a gilded, tuxedo inspired cake-over, and a cocktail to keep you awake until midnight. The only thing missing from the celebration is the ball drop!

programme.title: Wrap it Up!
programme.desc: First, Frankie packs a one-two punch of bargain and nutrition with butternut squash in three nostalgic, old school dishes. Then he shows you how to prep portable wraps at home for easy, peasey lunches.

programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter
programme.desc: Frankie gets cozy in the Struggle kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter. From a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal, these dishes are sure to keep you warm and cozy.

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Struggle Sandwich
programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Spice Is Nice
programme.desc: Flavor, flavor, flavor. Frankie shows us the way around the spice cabinet. All it takes is a couple primary dried spices to make a variety of homemade spice blends. Bonus: Frankie also tackles a monster challenge with our favorite monster guest!

programme.title: Rent Week
programme.desc: It’s the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge is looking pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and teaches us how to better prep for this time of the month.

programme.title: Beans Beans Beans
programme.desc: Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making super tasty recipes. Beans are the gift that keeps on giving, so don’t be scared to eat too many. Remember, they’re good for your heart.

programme.desc: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They’re an affordable plant-based meat replacement, packed with nutritional value. We’ll learn all things mushrooms and how to make inventive, flavorful dishes that might trip you out on their awesomeness.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep9
programme.desc: Fariz mengikuti gerak geri Tokwan dan mencari Ain hingga di kedai. Ain berpura-pura tidak mengenali Fariz. Dalam diam, Ain terluka dan terlalu merindui Fariz. Sementara itu, Fadzlan dan Rohana merancang untuk menyatukan Fariz bersama Rania yang turut sama memendam perasaan pada Fariz. Apakah Fariz akan bersetuju?

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep10
programme.desc: Rohana desak Fariz agar berkahwin dengan Rania. Bagaimanapun Fariz menolaknya dan bertegas walau apa cara sekalipun, dia akan tetap berkahwin dengan Ainnura. Dalam waktu yang sama, dalam usaha untuk mendapatkan nombor telefon Ainnura, Fariz sanggup ke pejabat Ainnura, bagaimanapun Iqram tidak setuju kerana bimbang rahsia Ainnura adalah bekas isteri Fariz akan terbongkar. Dalam waktu yang sama, Ilah berusaha dengan pelbagai cara agar Ainnura tidak rapat dengan Fariz.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt is asked by a local cat charity to treat a litter of tiny abandoned kittens. They're so weak, it's touch and go whether any of them will survive.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: A crazy animal expert raises hundreds of pets in their workplace; the super cute characteristics and breeding secrets of pet turtles are revealed; elementary school students' favorite beetle army attacks, tailor-made insect jelly taste super delicious; and animal therapist is now on duty, "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to visit a parent-child farm and get close to various cute pets.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: At Flamingoland, Oscar the male ostrich has been limping and Dr. Matt is determined to find out why.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got monkey criminals, magic and mirrors, cheeky monkeys, monkey pals, banana loving primates, baby monkeys, monkeys vs cameras, monkeys out on the town, and monkeys acting like us humans.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Huang Yunong's Yunong Reptile Studio has an extraordinary passion for geckos and he regards every gecko as his own. He always feel sad when consumers buy them, just like saying goodbye to his own child. He always shares care knowledge in great detail, and cultivates concepts through his own experience to let more people know more about hem. He hopes that through "Cute Pets Coming", the overall gecko raising environment can continue to improve.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Whilst the majority of us Brits look forward to the summer months, for the nations' dog rescuers, rising temperatures create a potentially lethal danger for the country's canines. In 2018 the RSPCA received over 7000 calls concerning dogs suffering in the hot weather, with nearly 2000 in July alone. In this hot weather special episode of -¥The Dog Rescuers' we see the mistakes people have made leaving their dogs and hear solutions and advice on how to keep your dog cool in the heat.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has been called to the Flamingoland aquarium, to set upright some upside-down male seahorses. He diagnoses gas bubble disease, which means a delicate operation to inject drugs directly into the tiny fish's pouch.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this special edition of the Dog Rescuers we go to Hong Kong. The RSPCA doesn't just look after the welfare of dogs here in the UK, but also collaborates with parts of Europe, Asia and Africa. In Hong Kong they've been working closely with local SPCA as they try to combat their ever growing stray dog population. As part of an exchange programme with the UK that has been running for over a decade, Inspector Herchy Boal has come to witness and learn about those problems first hand so the two charities can work together on future solutions.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Project Legion
programme.desc: A young man trapped in his apartment with a swarm of demons outside his door must find a way to survive the night and escape from apartment 213.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Broken Star
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep7

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep8

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Ep02 Roz cuba menenangkan Indah yang risaukan Rin dan Daniel yang telah mulakan penyiasatan. Namun Daniel tidak mahu mendengar nasihat ibunya, Roz. Daniel dan Roz menggunakan cara berbeza untuk mencari Rin. Pihak polis menerima rakaman pesanan suara Rin.

programme.title: SIX GUN SAVIOR
programme.desc: Lane McCrae will find himself double crossed after making a deal with the Devil to revive his dead brother.

programme.title: PART 1
programme.desc: Worldwide panic ensues when a scientist predicts sun will explode, bringing about the end of the world in seven days.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E03 - William And Kate A New Royal Family
programme.desc: 這是新皇家家庭的第一年，威廉王子和凱特迎來了一個男孩。

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?
programme.desc: Se calcula que hay aproximadamente 8,7 millones de especies diferentes de animales en la Tierra. Cada una de ellas ha desarrollado técnicas y habilidades de supervivencia únicas, específicas y a menudo mortales. ¿Cómo elegir un favorito entre un abanico tan amplio de criaturas espectaculares y hermosas?

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E01 - The Hills Have Fangs
programme.desc: Armado sólo con su ingenio, las herramientas y dispositivos más rudimentarios y cero armadura, el experto en depredadores Manny Puig te guiará por algunas de las aguas más turbias y los lugares más peligrosos del planeta. En este episodio, Manny Puig explora las cordilleras costeras del sur de California en busca de la supertóxica serpiente de cascabel del Pacífico Sur.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E02 - Blue Water Savages Part 1
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E03 - Blue Water Savages Part 2
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Tailandia es uno de los pocos países del sudeste asiático que nunca ha sido colonia europea. Quizá la palabra "thai", que significa "libre", tenga algo que ver con ello. Posiblemente sea la razón por la que este país evoca cierta magia que lo diferencia de los países de su entorno. De Tailandia viajamos a Sri Lanka.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of
programme.desc: Milagros de la Naturaleza ha viajado a los cuatro rincones de la Tierra - echamos la vista atrás a la asombrosa variedad de destinos visitados - cada uno de ellos ofrece vistas extraordinarias e impresionantes combinadas con historias dramáticas y una belleza sobrecogedora.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E05 - Alaska Caribou Part 2
programme.desc: En las profundidades del territorio de Alaska, Laramy caza caribúes hasta que un grave accidente con el Hawken pone en entredicho toda la cacería.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E06 - Montana Elk
programme.desc: ¿Podrá Laramy sobrevivir a las duras condiciones del territorio de los alces? Con un fallo de encendido y un nuevo manto de nieve sobre las montañas, la tarea de capturar un alce para el invierno se hace cada vez más difícil.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E07 - Blacksmith Show
programme.desc: Forjar sus propias herramientas era una valiosa habilidad para los montañeses. Laramy nos muestra cómo fabrica su propio equipo.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E08 - Idaho Elk

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E04 - Elizabeth At 80 Continuity And Change

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E11 - Operation Rogers Pass
programme.desc: 蒙大拿遊戲管理員布賴恩·戈利（Bryan Golie）幫助一名在森林中受傷的獵人。與此同時，其他管理員追踪一些試圖跳過檢查站的獵人，導致意想不到的結果。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E05 - Rising Waters
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer siguen avanzando río abajo, y a medida que se acerca la época de apareamiento de los alces, deben confiar más en pescar, cazar patos y recolectar bayas. Una enorme tormenta de lluvia de Alaska golpea, trayendo grandes desafíos para su éxito.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E06 - All Eyes On Us
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer are back at it, catching fish for dinner and getting closer to being able to leave. But things get tense when a grizzly bear wanders too close to their campsite, putting both brothers in danger!

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating
programme.desc: Bolivia es un país de innumerables y fascinantes paisajes naturales. Empezaremos en el altiplano, parando en el lago salado más grande del mundo. Después, descenderemos unos miles de metros por la carretera de la muerte hasta la provincia de Los Yungas. Y luego a orillas del lago Titicaca, el lago navegable más alto del mundo.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious
programme.desc: Zambia, la región letona de Kurzeme, las provincias georgianas de Kakheti y Svaneti, parecen tener muy poco en común. Se encuentran en África, Europa y en la frontera entre Europa y Asia, respectivamente. Kakheti y Svaneti forman parte de Georgia, pero son muy diferentes entre sí. Entonces, ¿dónde está la conexión? ¿En qué se parecen estas regiones?

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E09 - Lost Peg Leg Treasure
programme.desc: Tom y Kia buscan en el desierto el tesoro perdido de Pata de Palo.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E10 - Daylight and Gold
programme.desc: Es verano en Alaska y Tom y Kia aprovechan las 24 horas de luz.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E04 - No Win Scenario
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investiga un trágico ataque de cocodrilos en el río Zambeze de África.

programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E06 - All Eyes On Us
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer are back at it, catching fish for dinner and getting closer to being able to leave. But things get tense when a grizzly bear wanders too close to their campsite, putting both brothers in danger!

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating
programme.desc: Bolivia es un país de innumerables y fascinantes paisajes naturales. Empezaremos en el altiplano, parando en el lago salado más grande del mundo. Después, descenderemos unos miles de metros por la carretera de la muerte hasta la provincia de Los Yungas. Y luego a orillas del lago Titicaca, el lago navegable más alto del mundo.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious
programme.desc: Zambia, la región letona de Kurzeme, las provincias georgianas de Kakheti y Svaneti, parecen tener muy poco en común. Se encuentran en África, Europa y en la frontera entre Europa y Asia, respectivamente. Kakheti y Svaneti forman parte de Georgia, pero son muy diferentes entre sí. Entonces, ¿dónde está la conexión? ¿En qué se parecen estas regiones?

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E09 - Lost Peg Leg Treasure
programme.desc: Tom y Kia buscan en el desierto el tesoro perdido de Pata de Palo.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E10 - Daylight and Gold
programme.desc: Es verano en Alaska y Tom y Kia aprovechan las 24 horas de luz.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E04 - No Win Scenario
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investiga un trágico ataque de cocodrilos en el río Zambeze de África.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E04 - Elizabeth At 80 Continuity And Change
programme.desc: Thanks to the Queen’s dedication, Britain found a way to move past its empire days and create a successful new identity, surprising many experts. This is the story of an amazing woman and her amazing life.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E11 - Operation Rogers Pass
programme.desc: 蒙大拿遊戲管理員布賴恩·戈利（Bryan Golie）幫助一名在森林中受傷的獵人。與此同時，其他管理員追踪一些試圖跳過檢查站的獵人，導致意想不到的結果。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: 紀錄片《卡米拉女王？」更深入地探討了卡米拉·帕克·鮑爾斯，涵蓋了她的歷史、生活以及未來的方向。它集中於她與查爾斯王子的長期關係。該片還探討了卡米拉在查爾斯王子和戴安娜王妃婚姻中所扮演的角色的戲劇性。

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E12 - Operation Elk Dummy
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的遊戲管理員在全州設置假麋鹿以試圖抓捕潛在的偷獵者。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E07 - Salmon Island
programme.desc: Ahora que la mayor parte de las aves acuáticas se han dirigido más al sur para migrar, los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer están poniendo su esfuerzo en la pesca para obtener las calorías que necesitan. Están regresando río abajo después de empacar el campamento, enfocándose en un área que creen tiene varios alces.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E08 - Log Jammed
programme.desc: 當兄弟們接近一部分滿是駝鹿的河流時，他們面臨著一堆問題。他們必須找到繞過的方法，並把東西搬過一堆巨大的原木，這可能會破壞他們的獵遊，可能將他們推向一部分他們未準備好的河流。

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: En este episodio visitamos dos rincones diferentes de nuestro planeta. Aunque separados por miles de kilómetros, espiritualmente son parientes cercanos. En primer lugar, Etiopía, en África Oriental, diseccionada por el Gran Valle del Rift africano y considerada por muchos la cuna de la humanidad. A continuación, un paraíso en la Tierra: Jamaica.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E11 - Prospectors and Miners
programme.desc: Es un gran año para el campamento minero de Cripple River en Nome Alaska. El equipo está muy ocupado y los participantes ya están encontrando algunos de los mayores yacimientos de oro de la historia reciente.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E12 - One Dredge: Tons of Gold
programme.desc: Tom lleva un par de años dragando un lugar en Arctic creek. Ahora es el momento en que él y Kia van a abrir el agujero con la esperanza de encontrar algo de oro en serio.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E05 - Gang Wars
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investiga una operación de caza furtiva en el mercado negro africano.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: 儘管所有媒體的喧囂，其中許多並不算水準，哈里依然是一個謎。這部引人入勝的紀錄片提供了新視角和鏡頭，來揭示一位面對心痛和丑聞的皇室王子的故事。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: En zonas remotas, la supervivencia es un juego cotidiano. Los anfitriones Chris y Casey Keefer se proponen sobrevivir 30 días en plena naturaleza. Cada nuevo día, estos hermanos enfrentarán sus habilidades como cazadores, leñadores y pescadores a un paisaje implacable y despiadado. DROPPED enfrenta a los espectadores a la dura realidad de que sólo se puede comer lo que se puede matar. Una auténtica prueba de supervivencia.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer despiertan en una tundra helada. Con más de 8 millas por recorrer y sin remos, los hermanos se ven obligados a abrirse camino a través de aguas poco profundas y tierra estéril mientras se dirigen río abajo en busca de su segundo escondite.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E03 - Choke Point
programme.desc: El terreno empieza a cambiar a medida que los hermanos Keefer se ven obligados a abrirse camino río abajo. El paisaje se estrecha y conduce a los hermanos a un punto geográfico donde se reúnen depredadores y presas.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E04 - Bone Weary
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer se refugian en un pequeño pinar mientras una tormenta invernal asedia el río. Obligados a esperar a que pase el temporal, los hermanos intentan conservar la poca energía que les queda.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Utilizando sus últimas energías, los hermanos Keefer se dirigen río abajo en busca de su siguiente alijo. La marea cambia cuando finalmente logran salir de la tundra abierta y entrar en el corazón del territorio de los alces.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Abróchese el cinturón y manténgase alerta...... Horas desesperadas analiza los accidentes de tráfico y ferroviarios, entre ellos el accidente ferroviario español de Santiago de Compostela, un accidente de carretera en Pakistán, el accidente de un camión petrolero en Nigeria en el que murieron 96 personas, el accidente ferroviario del Queen of the Sea en Sri Lanka, los accidentes provocados por la niebla en Italia y el Reino Unido, un accidente de cien vehículos en la autopista A1 en Austria, un accidente de carretera en México y un accidente de Amtrak en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E13 - Desperate World
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas examina algunas de las peores catástrofes del mundo. Analiza la erupción del Eyjafjallajökull en Islandia, los terremotos de Nepal. epidemias como el ébola y el SARS, el incendio de la Zona de Nuevo Desarrollo de Binhai en China, el huracán Sandy en Nueva York, el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático, un destructivo sumidero en Bosnia, el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima, la catástrofe del gas de Bhopal, el accidente del Exxon Valdez en Alaska, y accidentes de tráfico y aéreos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick y Laura exploran la variedad de habilidades que utilizan los francotiradores militares: puntería, tiro a larga distancia, detección, acecho, camuflaje, infiltración, reconocimiento especial y adquisición de objetivos.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E05 - Fisherman's Catch
programme.desc: Bradley quiere ofrecer a un grupo de pescadores una cena inusual, algo totalmente inesperado. En el menú: caracoles de mar seguidos de un ambicioso plato de pepinos de mar y como plato principal un risotto de cangrejo Dungeness.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E06 - Alutiq Anniversary
programme.desc: La familia Ewing organiza una cena para celebrar el 20 aniversario del Museo AlutIq. En el menú: buñuelos de almejas con algas, algas con mermelada de ruibarbo y arándanos, carne de caza con puré de patatas al rábano picante con setas, espárragos y puerros. El reto consiste en elaborar una cena memorable con ingredientes locales para los habitantes de Alutiq y presentarla de una forma que nunca antes hayan probado.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E07 - Bush Pilot's Birthday
programme.desc: El cumpleaños de un piloto de Bush garantiza un menú exquisito con gambas del Pacífico y pasta para empezar el menú de este episodio seguido de pechuga de pato con raíz de apio y como plato principal hay conejo y zanahorias.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E01 - Ken Henderson Story
programme.desc: Los mejores amigos, Ed Cohen y Ken Henderson, salen dos días a pescar en el golfo de Texas. La tragedia golpea y los dos hombres quedan varados a la deriva en aguas hostiles.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: En zonas remotas, la supervivencia es un juego cotidiano. Los anfitriones Chris y Casey Keefer se proponen sobrevivir 30 días en plena naturaleza. Cada nuevo día, estos hermanos enfrentarán sus habilidades como cazadores, leñadores y pescadores a un paisaje implacable y despiadado. DROPPED enfrenta a los espectadores a la dura realidad de que sólo se puede comer lo que se puede matar. Una auténtica prueba de supervivencia.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer despiertan en una tundra helada. Con más de 8 millas por recorrer y sin remos, los hermanos se ven obligados a abrirse camino a través de aguas poco profundas y tierra estéril mientras se dirigen río abajo en busca de su segundo escondite.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E03 - Choke Point
programme.desc: El terreno empieza a cambiar a medida que los hermanos Keefer se ven obligados a abrirse camino río abajo. El paisaje se estrecha y conduce a los hermanos a un punto geográfico donde se reúnen depredadores y presas.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E04 - Bone Weary
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer se refugian en un pequeño pinar mientras una tormenta invernal asedia el río. Obligados a esperar a que pase el temporal, los hermanos intentan conservar la poca energía que les queda.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Utilizando sus últimas energías, los hermanos Keefer se dirigen río abajo en busca de su siguiente alijo. La marea cambia cuando finalmente logran salir de la tundra abierta y entrar en el corazón del territorio de los alces.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Abróchese el cinturón y manténgase alerta...... Horas desesperadas analiza los accidentes de tráfico y ferroviarios, entre ellos el accidente ferroviario español de Santiago de Compostela, un accidente de carretera en Pakistán, el accidente de un camión petrolero en Nigeria en el que murieron 96 personas, el accidente ferroviario del Queen of the Sea en Sri Lanka, los accidentes provocados por la niebla en Italia y el Reino Unido, un accidente de cien vehículos en la autopista A1 en Austria, un accidente de carretera en México y un accidente de Amtrak en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E13 - Desperate World
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas examina algunas de las peores catástrofes del mundo. Analiza la erupción del Eyjafjallajökull en Islandia, los terremotos de Nepal. epidemias como el ébola y el SARS, el incendio de la Zona de Nuevo Desarrollo de Binhai en China, el huracán Sandy en Nueva York, el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático, un destructivo sumidero en Bosnia, el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima, la catástrofe del gas de Bhopal, el accidente del Exxon Valdez en Alaska, y accidentes de tráfico y aéreos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
